app.name: Loctek desk
app.summary: A Loctek Motion or Flexispot desk on the screen: its height, sit, stand, up, down and the presets.
app.height_hint: Optional. The sensor Height of the LoctekMotion package. Without it the tile shows the cover's position.
app.sit_hint: Optional. The button Sit of the LoctekMotion package (Preset 4 on some panels).
app.stand_hint: Optional. The button Stand of the LoctekMotion package (Preset 3 on some panels).
app.preset_hint: Optional. A preset button of the LoctekMotion package.
app.child_lock_hint: Optional. The switch Child lock. The key holds it for five seconds; the desk does not say whether it is locked.
app.alarm_hint: Optional. The button or switch that sounds the desk's alarm, if the package has one.
app.manual_hint: The keys Up, Stop and Down. A tap starts a travel that runs until Stop or the end.
